{{AnimePokémonInfobox |trainername=Silver |pokemonname=Honchkrow |jtrainername=シルバー |jpokemonname=ドンカラス |tmtrainername=Silver |tmpokemonname=Dongkarasu |image=[[File:Silver Honchkrow.png|240px]] |caption=Silver's Honchkrow |location=Unknown |gender=Male |ability={{a|Insomnia}} |nature=Adamant |type1=Dark |type2=Flying |media=special |evolution=1 |numeps1=337 |firststagename=Murkrow |epnum=PS108 |epname=Quilava Quandary |firstevoep=PS445 |firstevoname=Dealing With A Koffing Fit |prevonum=198 |evo1num=430 |current=[[Party|With Silver]] |va=no }} '''Silver's Honchkrow''' (Japanese: '''シルバーのドンカラス''' ''Silver's Dongkarasu'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that {{adv|Silver}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and his fourth overall. As of ''[[PS454|All About Arceus III]]'', he is at [[level]] 79, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "quick tempered." ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}=== [[File:Silver and Honchkrow.png|thumb|left|150px|Honchkrow and Silver]] Prior to the start of the chapter, Murkrow was used to help {{adv|Silver}} track down [[Lance]], as seen in a flashback in ''[[PS159|Popular Pupitar]]''. After finding him, Murkrow battled his two {{p|Dragonair}}. Due to the darkness, Lance returned them, allowing Murkrow to attack with {{m|Pursuit}}. The attack struck his {{p|Pupitar}} and ended the quick battle. After this Lance read Murkrow's memories in order to figure out what Silver wanted from him. Honchkrow first appeared as a Murkrow in ''[[PS108|Quilava Quandary]]'', {{m|Fly|flying}} Silver over [[Ecruteak City]]. In ''[[PS110|Piloswine Whine]]'', Murkrow battled [[Team Rocket]]'s {{p|Piloswine}}. Utilizing his ability to fly, Silver avoided Piloswine's {{m|Earthquake}} and attacked it with [[Polibo]]. In ''[[PS111|Tyranitar War]]'', Murkrow participated in Silver's battle against {{adv|Gold}}. When Gold had Polibo attack Silver's {{p|Tyranitar}} with {{m|Water Gun}}, Murkrow blocked the attack with {{m|Wing Attack}}, allowing Tyranitar to finish Polibo off. [[PS112|Later]], Murkrow helped Silver capture the [[Red Gyarados]], using Pursuit to stop him from retreating. In ''[[PS114|Delibird Delivery - 2]]'', Murkrow chased the [[Masked Man]] and his {{p|Delibird}} after the two fled from battle. After catching up, Murkrow attempted to attack Delibird but was quickly attacked in return by {{m|Blizzard}}. The Masked Man further taunted Silver by telling him that he played right into his trap. Despite this, Silver recovered and had Murkrow deliver a barrage of {{m|Peck}}s at the Masked Man. Silver then used his {{TP|Silver|Gyarados}} to bring all the {{p|Gyarados}} that were forcibly [[Evolution|evolved]] to him and launched a powerful {{m|Hyper Beam}} at him. Despite the attack, though, Silver was quickly defeated. Murkrow reappeared alongside the rest of Silver's team in ''[[PS145|Sandslash Surprise]]'' to help defeat a group of {{p|Sandslash}}. In ''[[PS177|The Last Battle XI]]'', Murkrow battled alongside Silver's other Pokémon to defeat [[Will]] by attacking with {{TP|Silver|Sneasel}}'s {{m|Beat Up}}. ==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}=== [[File:Razor Claw Dusk Stone Adventures.png|thumb|200px|The Dusk Stone Murkrow used to evolve]] In ''[[PS289|Surprised by Sneasel]]'', Murkrow battled [[Sird]] and her {{p|Banette}}. Silver sent Murkrow to attack, only for him to be easily tossed aside by Banette. ==={{MangaArc|HeartGold & SoulSilver}}=== In ''[[PS445|Dealing With A Koffing Fit]]'', Silver arrived at Lance's [[Whirl Islands|secret hideout]] and was soon attacked by a group of [[Petrel]]'s {{p|Koffing}}. Murkrow and the rest of Silver's team managed to drive off the large horde of the Poison Gas Pokémon. Soon after, Murkrow and Sneasel [[Evolution|evolve]]d into {{p|Honchkrow}} and {{p|Weavile}}, respectively, due to the respective [[Dusk Stone]] and [[Razor Fang]] that were given to them by {{adv|Green}}. In ''[[PS448|Pleased as Punch With Parasect]]'', Honchkrow was seen saving Silver from an attack from [[Ariana]]'s {{p|Arbok}}. Soon after saving him, however, Honchkrow was hit by {{m|Glare}} and taken out of the fight. In ''[[PS456|All About Arceus V]]'', Silver and Honchkrow flew towards the center of the [[Sinjoh Ruins|Mystri Stage]] in order to distract Team Rocket, allowing Gold and {{adv|Crystal}} to launch {{m|Frenzy Plant|the}} {{m|Blast Burn|ultimate}} {{m|Hydro Cannon|moves}} at {{adv|Arceus}}'s {{adv|Pokémon of myth|creations}}. ==Personality and characteristics== Honchkrow is often very quiet and tends to stay towards the sidelines unless needed. Despite this, he is a fierce and powerful Pokémon, which is often seen when someone he cares about is in trouble. Honchkrow is also very stubborn at times and refuses to change his mind when he sets himself to a goal. He is {{adv|Silver}}'s main means of aerial transportation. As mentioned by [[Lance]], Honchkrow has a strong memory and can remember everything that his {{pkmn|Trainer}} has said and does. ==Appearance== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{dark color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{dark color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{flying color light}}; {{roundytop|5px}}" | As a {{pcolor|Murkrow|000}} |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Silver Murkrow.png|200px]] |} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|Dark|Flying|Silver {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Murkrow Fly|1=Murkrow Wing Attack|2=Murkrow Pursuit|3=Murkrow Peck|4=Honchkrow Fly}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Fly as a Murkrow|1=Wing Attack as a Murkrow|2=Pursuit as a Murkrow|3=Peck as a Murkrow|4=Fly}}}} {{anmov|Flying|Fly|PS108|Quilava Quandary}} {{anmov|Flying|Wing Attack|PS111|Tyranitar War}} {{anmov|Dark|Pursuit|PS112|Raise the Red Gyarados}} {{anmov|Flying|Peck|PS114|Delibird Delivery - 2}} {{anmov/f|Flying}} ==Trivia== * In the VIZ Media edition of [[Pokémon Adventures volume 41]], Honchkrow, along with {{TP|Silver|Weavile}}, are mistakenly labeled as females. ==Related articles== {{Animespeciesevo1|Murkrow|Honchkrow}}
